name: llm-runner
description: LLM runner interface for prompterator. Reads a user prompt from stdin and writes the LLM response to stdout.
command-line: llm-runner [--system SYSTEM] [--temperature TEMPERATURE] [--max-tokens MAX_TOKENS] [--model MODEL] [--endpoint ENDPOINT] [--api-version API_VERSION] [--output-dir OUTPUT_DIR] [--descriptor]

inputs.name: System prompt
inputs.description: System prompt to prepend to the conversation.

inputs.name: Max tokens
inputs.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate.

inputs.name: API version
inputs.description: API version string (used by Azure OpenAI).

inputs.name: Output directory
inputs.description: Directory for sidecar artifacts (images, audio, etc.) produced by runners whose output is not purely textual. Text-only runners ignore this flag. Runners that honor it choose their own filenames within the directory.

inputs.name: Descriptor
inputs.description: Print the Boutiques descriptor JSON and exit.

output-files.name: LLM response
output-files.description: LLM response text written to stdout (or JSON descriptor when --descriptor is used).

output-files.name: Sidecar artifact
output-files.description: For runners that produce non-textual artifacts (e.g. an author runner emitting an image): the file is written inside --output-dir, and its absolute path is echoed on stdout as 'IMAGE: <path>' (or similar protocol line). Text-only runners produce nothing here.

error-codes.description: Error (missing API key, invalid input, API failure, etc.).

prompterator.stdout: LLM response text (plain) or Boutiques JSON (with --descriptor)
